metric_definition: APPROXIMATE stage attribution of non-self frames on p0022's entity. group_over_attribution = multiple pids at same frame (GROUP node). ilp_stitch = tracklet's majority GT is someone else (solver connected wrong tracklet). tracklet_impurity = tracklet 'belongs' to tagged but frame-level GT differs (tracker swap). This is approximate — angles 5+6 are the load-bearing discriminators.
caveat: APPROXIMATE. Overlapping categories possible. Use angles 5+6 for decisions.
